name: ironflock
description: Operate IronFlock: connects Claude to your IronFlock instance, in the cloud or on an appliance, through IronFlock's MCP endpoint and an API key that you enter in Claude's settings, with the skill to set up and check that connection. More skills to operate IronFlock come in later releases; the skills to build apps and widgets are in ironflock-dev.

api_url.title: IronFlock API address
api_url.description: The address of your IronFlock instance's API, without /mcp at the end. Keep https://api.ironflock.com for IronFlock in the cloud. For an appliance, enter https://api.<your appliance's domain>.

api_key.title: IronFlock API key
api_key.description: An API key you created in IronFlock Studio under Account Settings > Developer > API keys. It is kept in your system's secure credential store, not in a settings file.
